title: Living maps: views, living regions, figures, arrows and overlays

shots.vo: Three rivals each held a region.
An empire stretching across the world.
The whole world joined in.
The generals planned their next move.
Then the country split in two.
The empire broke into dozens of states.
It bled money from the inside.
And it was swallowed by its neighbour.
Territory slipped away piece by piece.
The idea spread across the country.
Then they took the east, then the south.
One was in love, one got beaten, one did not care.
He conquered region after region.
West declared war on East.
Everyone fought everyone.
They built forts along the river, and the east burned.
The army marched in and took the south.
They claimed it, traded, crossed it off and closed the gate.
West and East. And the South.
They patched it up, then crushed the legions.
